decisions.reason: The carpentry workshop provides meaningful sheltered employment, uses the firm's production know-how and has its own web page, so withdrawal remains unlikely.
Senior living counseling is low-cost, close to core eldercare, channels clients to the firm's facilities and is featured prominently.
The retail shop supports inclusion and sales of workshop products, but its retail overhead and low visibility leave it moderately at risk.
Meal delivery for seniors complements outpatient eldercare and has steady demand, though it is newly launched with only minor web presence and thin logistics margins.
